name: Mireth Tamarind-Coconut Calm Gummies
description: Soft, translucent gummies in tamarind-coconut flavor carrying a light synth-serotonin precursor compound intended to produce a mild mood lift over 3-4 hours — one of Mireth's entry-level mood-candy offerings.
flavor_profile: Tangy tamarind with a creamy coconut finish; soft bite with a slight chewback, coated in a fine sugar-acid dust that amplifies the tamarind sourness on first contact
cultural_context: Mireth Calm Gummies occupy a gray zone between wellness supplement and recreational candy; they're sold openly but carry a small bioactive disclosure stamp that most consumers ignore, and are popular in Tier 2 households as a low-cost mental health management tool.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 community health worker discovers that Mireth Calm Gummies are being prescribed as an unofficial substitute for actual mental health care by overwhelmed Tier 2 clinics — and Mireth's sales team is actively encouraging this.
Someone is selling counterfeit Mireth gummies with dramatically higher bioactive doses, triggering a wave of mood dysregulation incidents in a specific district.
A character whose BCI is synced to emotional monitoring software notices their 'calm' data is being sold to Mireth for market research — without their knowledge.
